description: Prefill the Text Message Chat Maker: a text conversation that appears bubble by bubble, with typing dots and your own names. Returns a link that opens the Tool with these options; the user presses Export there to download the video. All options are optional. Icons, images and audio that need a file upload are not supported.

avatar.description: Show the left speaker's round letter avatar in the header and beside their bubbles. Off by default. Default: false.

bg.description: Background color around the chat screen. Default: "#00ff00".

chat.description:
The whole chat as one text: one line per message, each starting with "<" for a message from the left speaker or ">" for one from the right speaker, then the message text. For example "<Are you there?" then a new line and ">Yes". Default: "<Okay, don't freak out
>That sentence always makes me freak out
<I finally told my boss what I think of the new coffee machine
>You did WHAT?
<I said it tastes like a warm sock
>And? What did she say?".

font.description: Font id of the text. Default: "inter".

hcolor.description: Color of the header bar. Overrides the color of the look. Default: "#f6f7f9".

header.description: Show the header with the left speaker's name (and avatar, when the avatar is on). Default: true.

hname.description: Show the left speaker's name next to the avatar in the header. Default: true.

lcolor.description: Bubble color of the speaker on the left. Default: "#e5e7eb".

left.description: Name of the speaker on the left. It is the header's contact name and the label in their bubbles. Default: "Emma".

look.description: Light or dark chat screen. It also sets the screen and header colors; pass scolor and hcolor to change them. Default: "light".

names.description: Show each speaker's name above their bubbles, once at the start of each run of messages from the same speaker. Default: true.

pace.description: How fast the messages follow each other. Default: "normal".

rcolor.description: Bubble color of the speaker on the right. Also the avatar's color. Default: "#7c3aed".

right.description: Name of the speaker on the right. It is the label in their bubbles. Default: "Jake".

scolor.description: Color of the chat screen behind the bubbles. Overrides the color of the look. Default: "#ffffff".

typing.description: Show typing dots before each message on the left. Default: true.

name: create_text_message_chat_maker
title: Text Message Chat Maker
